The odds ratio (ALKS3831/olanzapine) for having a 10% or greater increase in weight from baseline to Week 24 was 0.50 (95% CI: 0.31, 0.80). The proportion of patients who gained 10% or more weight from their baseline was significantly lower for ALKS 3831 (17.8%) than for olanzapine (29.9%)

target_moa.text: Fixed-dose combination of olanzapine (atypical antipsychotic; efficacy proposed via dopamine and serotonin type 2 (5HT2) antagonism) and samidorphan, an opioid receptor antagonist that acts primarily as a mu-opioid antagonist and is intended to mitigate olanzapine-associated weight gain

citations.quote: LYBALVI is a fixed-dose combination of OLZ and SAM. The exact mechanism of action of OLZ is unknown. However, it has been proposed that its efficacy in schizophrenia is mediated through a combination of dopamine and serotonin type 2 (5HT2) antagonism.
SAM binds with high affinity to human \mu-, \kappa-, and \delta-opioid receptors and acts primarily as an antagonist at \mu receptors, with low intrinsic activity at \kappa and \delta receptors.
Rather, the opioid antagonism conferred by SAM is intended to mitigate weight gain associated with OLZ treatment.

modality.text: small molecule (fixed-dose oral combination of olanzapine and samidorphan L-malate)

citations.quote: ALKS 3831 is an oral, fixed-dose combination of OLZ and SAM intended for the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder. OLZ is an atypical antipsychotic. SAM functions as an opioid receptor antagonist and is included to mitigate OLZ-induced weight gain.

summary.text: LYBALVI was approved as a 505(b)(2) NDA with a new molecular entity (samidorphan) under standard review. Efficacy relied on a PK bridge to olanzapine plus Study A305 demonstrating antipsychotic efficacy, and Study A303 demonstrating weight mitigation versus olanzapine. The original application received a Complete Response in the first review cycle due to manufacturing deficiencies; the resubmission was approved. A joint PDAC/DSaRM advisory committee was convened; no REMS was required.
